summary: Iter228 — Integrators lifecycle guard, Cerrar Proyecto flow, Matrix read-only guard, Asignación de Ambiente de Prueba, and Otras Acciones catalog. 12/12 backend tests PASSED. Frontend key elements verified: purple 'AMBIENTE DE PRUEBA' scope-tag, business-days countdown chip ('6 días háb.'), wizard 'Asignación de Ambiente de Prueba' option with mandatory start/end date fields, existing-integrator matching flow.

issues: Console warnings: <span> inside <tr> (hydration warning) and DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby. Non-blocking accessibility/SSR hints only.

action_items: (Optional/low-priority) Fix DialogContent aria-describedby warning in Integrators create dialog for accessibility.
(Optional/low-priority) Fix nested <span> inside <tr> hydration warning on the integrators grid.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/integrators.py update_integrator correctly preserves project_scope + integrator_status. Cerrado is protected both ways (no close via edit; no reactivation via edit).
IntegratorCreate.integrator_status Literal excludes 'Cerrado' → any client PUT with 'Cerrado' fails at Pydantic layer (422). Good defense-in-depth.
close endpoint dispatches 'integration_project_closed' inside try/except and returns 'notification' key even if dispatch has no configured recipients — verified.
Matrix read-only guard: only triggers when 'certifications' key is present AND different from stored; safe against no-op payloads.
assign_test_environment stores ISO dates and unsets closed_at/closed_by, guaranteeing that a reassignment on a previously-closed integrator restores active-project state.
GET /api/integrators computes test_env_days_left via business_days_between per test-env record; returns int (verified in test).
other_actions_config catalog includes both new action IDs with label + variables (verified). Endpoint for save/upsert is PUT /api/other-actions/configs (plural) — confirmed reachable.

Integrators.jsx: isActiveProject() checks scope in (new/component/expansion/test_environment) AND status != 'Cerrado'. Both matrix-readonly banner and disabled cert buttons are gated by this predicate correctly.
File size: /app/backend/routes/integrators.py is ~1970 lines — approaching the >700-line guideline. Consider splitting into submodules (crud vs. lifecycle vs. reports).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (visible testids and wizard verified; matrix expansion could not be triggered via my selectors, but code paths and disabled flags are correct per source review)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral QATEST_-prefixed integrators created for tests and fully deleted at end. Verified 0 QATEST_ remain; 'Saint de Venezuela' preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 backend tests pass. To re-verify frontend matrix-readonly banner interactively, disable 'Solo Proyectos' filter, find the closed row, and click the row's chevron/expand-row control (not the row body — that opens the contact hover popover). Existing testid for the matrix-readonly banner is 'matrix-readonly-{integrator_id}' and cert buttons use 'cert-{id}-{svc}'. Wizard test-env flow works end-to-end: existing-name match → 'Asignación de Ambiente de Prueba' → dates → 'Asignar Ambiente de Prueba' button.
